conflicts.legacy: Older documents claim a flat or completely singularity-free centre.
conflicts.resolution: The P0/current scope supersedes legacy claims.

conflicts.current: Horizon coefficients and horizon curvature may be finite; this implies nothing about r=0.
conflicts.legacy: Horizon regularisation was generalised into complete singularity freedom.
conflicts.resolution: Keep the two regions strictly separate.

conflicts.current: The P0 directive requires a quintic Hermite connection matching endpoint values, slopes and curvatures.
conflicts.legacy: The supplied dashboard used a cubic C¹ smoothstep without the correct derivatives.
conflicts.resolution: The interactive portal implements and tests the endpoint-derivative-matched quintic.

conflicts.current: The P0 derivative-matched construction is the portal reference.
conflicts.legacy: The current segmented-calculation-suite xi.py calls a quintic zero-slope smoothstep C² although blending the two non-flat functions does not match their endpoint derivatives globally.
conflicts.resolution: Expose the implementation conflict; do not silently use the smoothstep result as the canonical bridge.

conflicts.legacy: Reversed exponents or global saturation variants with the wrong far-field limit.
conflicts.resolution: The decay form is the operational strong branch; forbidden variants remain historical only.

conflicts.current: The portal separates extracted test definitions, audit runs and repository totals.
conflicts.legacy: Counts such as 1,125+, 2,000+ or 522 were compared without identical scope.
conflicts.resolution: Every number receives a source, date and counting method.

conflicts.current: Display only values with explicit metric, derivation and test provenance as model results.
conflicts.legacy: Approximations or repository descriptions were sometimes presented as universally canonical.
conflicts.resolution: Classify them as computed model results, not observational confirmation.

conflicts.current: Compatibility, fit, prediction and confirmation remain distinct.
conflicts.legacy: Individual audits use wording such as “proven” or “perfect coherence”.
conflicts.resolution: Use cautious epistemic categories and state boundaries throughout the portal.
